metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: (Mean ordered off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2 over at most 2048 real item embeddings sampled with seed 42. PAD/MASK excluded. 0.5 means approximately zero mean cosine; capacity or quality is not established. Null if fewer than two or nonfinite observations.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_sample_count: Number of sampled real item embeddings, not number of pairs.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: In-sample mean positive-minus-negative logit over verified masked supervised positions. Higher means stronger sampled-pair separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: In-sample nearest-rank 10th percentile of those margins, in logit units.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of verified supervised positions with negative-minus-positive logit > 0; lower is better.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of verified supervised positions with positive-minus-negative logit < 0.5.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_count: Number of verified supervised positions in at most ten loader batches; zero observations yield null statistics.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Unavailable: item categories are not supplied. Category lists remain empty.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:sampler_contract: Checks PAD=0, MASK=itemnum+1, real supervised IDs, and the supplied all-MASK corruption policy. Failure blocks sensitivity. Does not establish sampler provenance from tensors alone.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:serving_parity: Evaluation mode, float32, atol=1e-5/rtol=1e-4. The exported loader reloads exactly the current category checkpoint; every state tensor must exactly match the actual diagnostic model. Compare explicit fixed-position and ModelView features at visible positions, their MASK logits, internal appended-MASK scoring, exported predict, and batched/individual scoring. Scores must be finite and all ordered rankings identical. Rankings use descending score then ascending item ID; top10 agreement is intersection size/10. Short, full-length, truncated, and batched coverage are all required before sensitivity. External-label mutation remains explicitly untested; no hidden labels are accessed.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:history_sensitivity: Training-prefix diagnostic, not host validation. Uniformly select up to 64 users before inspecting outcomes, one endpoint/user uniformly among endpoints with >=4 preceding interactions and a target absent from the complete prefix. Negatives are 99 unique real items absent from that complete prefix and distinct from target; later events never determine eligibility. Seed 42. Complete-prefix exclusions and candidates remain fixed across all variants. Serving truncates to maxlen-1 and appends MASK at index maxlen-1. Delete earliest/latest k=min(2,floor((visible_count-1)/2)) visible items into attention-masked PAD holes; preserve surviving absolute positions and MASK index, without backfill. Swap final two visible items. Repeated historical IDs are permitted. Unknown IDs are excluded and counted, not negative labels.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:paired_statistics: Variant minus original: target_score_delta in logits; target_rank_delta in one-based positions (positive means deterioration); reciprocal_rank_delta uses 1/rank; diagnostic_hit10_delta uses indicator(rank<=10). top10_overlap is intersection/10; ordered_ranking_agreement compares complete ordered candidate rankings. Equal-user category means and 500 CPU paired-user bootstrap replicates, seed 42, percentile 95% intervals. Intervals cover sampled-user uncertainty only. Raw paired outcomes are retained for a four-category aggregation; that macro is unavailable in a single-category ModelView, never computed over fewer categories.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:elapsed_diagnostic_seconds: Wall seconds including warmup, loading, probes, and CPU bootstrap, CUDA synchronized at both boundaries; all diagnostic GPU work consumes search budget.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:availability: Null means unavailable; counts/exclusions and parity coverage must accompany interpretation. No ratings, review text, item categories/prices/stores, or simulator traits are measured.
